# golden-path

The smallest complete feature: entity, write handler, event, projection, screen and an integration test.

## README

# Golden path

The smallest complete Kumiko feature: one entity, one write handler that emits
an event, one projection, one screen, and an integration test that writes
through HTTP and reads the result back. Every other recipe is a variation on
this shape. The walkthrough is in [`docs/golden-path.md`](../../../docs/golden-path.md).

## What it shows

- **Entity** — `ticketEntity` declares `title` and `isClosed`. `r.crud` registers
  `ticket:create`, `ticket:list` and `ticket:detail` for it; update and delete
  are switched off with `verbs`.
- **Write handler** — `ticket:close` checks that the ticket exists and emits the
  `ticket-closed` event. It never touches the table.
- **Event** — `r.defineEvent` declares `ticket-closed` with a Zod payload;
  `emitEvent` appends it to the ticket's stream in the handler's transaction.
- **Projection** — `ticket-status` folds `ticket-closed` into the ticket row
  (`isClosed: true`), in the same transaction as the write.
- **Screen** — `ticket-list` is a declarative `entityList`; the renderer builds
  the UI from it.
- **Test** — `setupTestStack` boots the real server and database;
  `stack.http.writeOk` and `queryOk` go over HTTP. Each test runs in its own
  tenant.

## Files

```
src/feature.ts                          entity, event, handler, projection, screen
src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts   write → read back, access, not found
```

## Source files

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { ticketingFeature } from "../feature";

type TicketRow = { id: string; title: string; isClosed: boolean };

let stack: TestStack;
let nextTenant = 1;
let admin = createTestUser({ roles: ["Admin"], tenantId: testTenantId(nextTenant) });
let agent = createTestUser({ id: 2, roles: ["User"], tenantId: testTenantId(nextTenant) });

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [ticketingFeature], systemHooks: [] });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

// A fresh tenant per test keeps rows from other tests out of every list.
beforeEach(() => {
  nextTenant += 1;
  admin = createTestUser({ roles: ["Admin"], tenantId: testTenantId(nextTenant) });
  agent = createTestUser({ id: 2, roles: ["User"], tenantId: testTenantId(nextTenant) });
});

async function openTicket(title: string): Promise<string> {
  const created = await stack.http.writeOk<{ id: string }>(
    "ticketing:write:ticket:create",
    { title },
    agent,
  );
  return created.id;
}

async function readTicket(id: string): Promise<TicketRow> {
  return stack.http.queryOk<TicketRow>("ticketing:query:ticket:detail", { id }, agent);
}

describe("golden path: ticket", () => {
  test("a new ticket starts open", async () => {
    const id = await openTicket("Printer is on fire");

    expect(await readTicket(id)).toMatchObject({ title: "Printer is on fire", isClosed: false });
  });

  test("closing a ticket emits an event that the projection folds into the read model", async () => {
    const id = await openTicket("Login fails");

    await stack.http.writeOk(
      "ticketing:write:ticket:close",
      { id, resolution: "Password reset" },
      admin,
    );

    expect(await readTicket(id)).toMatchObject({ title: "Login fails", isClosed: true });
    const list = await stack.http.queryOk<{ rows: TicketRow[] }>(
      "ticketing:query:ticket:list",
      { filter: { field: "isClosed", op: "eq", value: true } },
      agent,
    );
    expect(list.rows.map((row) => row.id)).toEqual([id]);
  });

  test("closing an already closed ticket is rejected with 422", async () => {
    const id = await openTicket("Duplicate close");
    const close = { id, resolution: "Fixed" };
    await stack.http.writeOk("ticketing:write:ticket:close", close, admin);

    const again = await stack.http.writeErr("ticketing:write:ticket:close", close, admin);

    expect(again.httpStatus).toBe(422);
    expect(again.details).toEqual({ reason: "ticket_already_closed" });
  });

  test("only an Admin may close a ticket", async () => {
    const id = await openTicket("Slow wifi");

    const denied = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "ticketing:write:ticket:close",
      { id, resolution: "Moved the router" },
      agent,
    );

    expect(denied.code).toBe("access_denied");
    expect((await readTicket(id)).isClosed).toBe(false);
  });

  test("closing an unknown ticket fails with not_found", async () => {
    const missing = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "ticketing:write:ticket:close",
      { id: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", resolution: "n/a" },
      admin,
    );

    expect(missing.code).toBe("not_found");
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
import {
  createBooleanField,
  createEntity,
  createEntityExecutor,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
  emitEvent,
  setFields,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { failNotFound, failUnprocessable } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import { z } from "zod";

export const ticketEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_golden_path_tickets",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    isClosed: createBooleanField({ default: false }),
  },
});

export const ticketingFeature = defineFeature("ticketing", (r) => {
  const { table: ticketTable, executor: ticketExecutor } = createEntityExecutor(
    "ticket",
    ticketEntity,
  );

  r.crud("ticket", ticketEntity, {
    write: { access: { roles: ["Admin", "User"] } },
    read: { access: { roles: ["Admin", "User"] } },
    verbs: { update: false, delete: false },
  });

  const ticketClosed = r.defineEvent("ticket-closed", z.object({ resolution: z.string().min(1) }), {
    piiFields: "none",
  });

  r.writeHandler({
    name: "ticket:close",
    schema: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), resolution: z.string().min(1) }),
    access: { roles: ["Admin"] },
    handler: async (event, ctx) => {
      const ticket = await ticketExecutor.detail({ id: event.payload.id }, event.user, ctx.db);
      if (!ticket) {
        return failNotFound("ticket", event.payload.id);
      }
      if (ticket["isClosed"]) return failUnprocessable("ticket_already_closed");
      await emitEvent(ctx, ticketClosed, {
        aggregateId: event.payload.id,
        aggregateType: "ticket",
        payload: { resolution: event.payload.resolution },
      });
      return { isSuccess: true as const, data: { id: event.payload.id } };
    },
  });

  r.projection({
    name: "ticket-status",
    source: "ticket",
    table: ticketTable,
    apply: {
      [ticketClosed.name]: setFields(ticketTable, { isClosed: true }),
    },
  });

  r.screen({
    id: "ticket-list",
    type: "entityList",
    entity: "ticket",
    columns: ["title", "isClosed"],
  });
});
```
